guia.title: Start with *you*, without guilt.
guia.text: From what you tell me, what weighs on you most is how you feel after you react. I want you to know something: you are not a bad mom. You are a mom who is noticing, and that is already the first step. My guide is my gift to help you start.
guia.more: Whenever you want to go further: Límites sin culpa

limites.title: *Limits* are your thing, and they can be learned.
limites.text: You want to give your child what you did not have, and along the way it is hard to hold a “no” without giving in or ending up yelling. That does not make you a bad mom: it makes you a mom who needs tools. I wrote Límites sin culpa for exactly this moment.
limites.free_first: I would rather start with the free one

cita.title: You deserve *closer* support.
cita.text: From what you tell me, what you are going through at home calls for more than a guide: for us to look at it together, calmly and without judgment. I would love to support you in an online session, wherever you are.
cita.free_meanwhile: Meanwhile, start with my free guide
